* Machine Learning

Machine Learning is a subcategory of Artificial Intelligence
It allows computers to learn from data and improve their performance without being directly programmed for every task
In Machine Learning there are different algorithms that help the computer learn patterns from data and make predictions or decisions


-------Types of Machine Learning

There are mainly four types of Machine Learning

1-----Supervised Learning

In supervised learning the model learns from labelled data
This means the input data already has the correct answer
The model learns the relationship between input and output and then predicts the output for new data

Example
If we give the model pictures of cats and dogs with their names already given
The model learns the difference between them and can identify whether a new picture is a cat or dog

Examples of algorithms

Linear Regression
Decision Tree
K Nearest Neighbors
Support Vector Machine


2------Unsupervised Learning


In unsupervised learning the model learns from unlabelled data
There is no predefined correct answer
The model tries to find patterns groups or relationships in the data on its own

Example
If we give customer data to the model without telling it which customers belong to which group
The model can automatically group customers with similar behaviour

Example algorithm
K Means Clustering

3-------Reinforcement Learning

In reinforcement learning the model learns by trial and error
The model performs an action and receives a reward or penalty
It learns which actions give better results and tries to improve its decisions

Example
A robot learning how to walk
If it takes a correct step it gets a reward
If it falls it gets a penalty
Over time it learns the correct actions

4--------Semi Supervised Learning

Semi supervised learning uses a combination of labelled and unlabelled data
Usually only a small amount of data is labelled while a large amount is unlabelled
The model uses both types of data to learn

Example
Suppose we have 1000 images
Only 100 images are labelled as cat or dog
The remaining 900 images have no labels

The model uses the labelled images along with the unlabelled images to improve its learning



Supervised → Teacher gives answers

Unsupervised → No answers, find patterns yourself

Reinforcement → Learn through reward and penalty

Semi supervised → Some answers + lots of data without answers




-------Examples of Machine Learning algorithms include

Linear Regression
Decision Tree
K Nearest Neighbors
Support Vector Machine
Naive Bayes
Random Forest
K Means Clustering

--conclusion-
AI is the bigger field
Machine Learning is a part of AI
Deep Learning is a part of Machine Learning
